entry.external_evidence: Not yet in durable storage. Renders and boards were made in the build session and can be regenerated from tools/catalogue_laneway_house_pilot.
limitations: Fixed native assembly, 9.04 m by 12.2 m including gutters, the paved apron and the garden step; no resizing and no repetition.

The variant name Garden Studio and its catalogue text describe a different, single-storey building. The model follows the three images, which show a two-storey laneway house over a garage. A person must rule on the name and text before activation.
The back and west faces are inferred; no reference shows them.
Three doors: the front door on the porch, a garden door at the back and the garage door. The front and garden doors are one 0.18 m step above grade.
Terrain fit, entrance routing and every runtime gate are untested; see tools/catalogue_laneway_house_pilot/integration/runtime-review.md.
No independent review yet: RLASM Gate G is open.

picker.description: Two-storey laneway house over a double garage, in brick and cedar, with a balcony, corner window and hipped metal roof.
picker.reshape_description: Move and rotate the complete house. It keeps its authored size.
